description: This file defines a React functional component 'ModelInfoView' which manages the display and editing of model information within a dashboard interface. It includes features like viewing model details, editing settings, testing connection, reusing credentials, and deleting models. The component interacts with external APIs and utilities, such as fetching model info, guardrails, tags, and submitting updates.

methods.name: handleReuseCredential
methods.description: Handles storing a credential for reusing with this model by calling credentialCreateCall API.

methods.name: handleModelUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating the model configuration by submitting form data via API and updating local state.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the model using provided credentials and parameters.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current model after confirmation via API.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to clipboard and manages UI state for success indication.

methods.name: handleAutoRouterUpdate
methods.description: Updates local model data upon successful auto-router editing.
